How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen for digestive health, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

settings.title: How does CBD help with recovery?
settings.text: The skin contains a high concentration of cannabinoid receptors, and when you apply CBD topically, it activates the endocannabinoid system through those receptors. The endocannabinoid system is responsible for many physiological processes, including muscle soreness, and immune function, which CBD can regulate and improve.

settings.title: Can I use CBD recovery cream alongside other CBD products?
settings.text: Yes, you can use CBD cream with other products such as capsules, gummies and powder. But start with small amounts and build up gradually until you find the right levels for your body, and don’t exceed the recommended dosage.

settings.title: Does CBD Make You High?
settings.text:
No - CBD will not make you high. This is because CBD is a completely different compound to that of THC (the intoxicating constituent of the cannabis plant). 

Hemp-derived CBD products are non-intoxicating and have zero psychoactive properties. High-quality CBD products can be used safely in your daily routine to support health and promote wellbeing.

settings.title: Is CBD Legal?
settings.text:
Yes, CBD products are legal but they must meet regulatory standards. The World Health Organization describes CBD as “generally well tolerated” and as having “a good safety profile”. 

Therefore it is important to only use high-quality CBD products from trusted retailers.
